layout.container: w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 pb-28

ergonomics.thumb_zone: Sticky save button at bottom, critical actions in natural thumb reach
ergonomics.one_handed_use: Full-width inputs, stacked columns, massive hit areas for checkboxes/radios/chips

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky top bar containing Buscema Gastronomia mock logo (Text + Chef Hat icon in Gold), and dynamic 'Nome Fiera + Anno'. Bottom border with subtle 3-pixel Italian tricolor line.

sections.name: Trigger Acquisizione
sections.description: Hybrid capture area. Two large, thumb-friendly buttons stacked vertically on mobile.

sections.name: Anagrafica
sections.description: Standard contact form. Name, Surname, Email, Phone, Company, Role.

sections.name: Tipologia Azienda
sections.description: Multi-select company type. Render as a wrapping flexbox of toggleable Chips (Badges) for ergonomic 1-tap selection on mobile.

sections.name: Interesse & Packaging
sections.description: Checkboxes for Interest (Brand vs Products) and Packaging/Format options. Grouped logically with Gold accent lines.

sections.name: Progetto & Campioni
sections.description: Text fields or large touch toggles to detail the prospect's project and sample requests.

sections.name: Valutazione
sections.description: Priority rating (A/B/C/D) using a massive 2x2 grid of Radio button cards. 5-star interactive rating component for Potential.

sections.name: Note
sections.description: Free text area for additional notes.

sections.name: Sticky Save
sections.description: Fixed bottom bar with a massive 'Salva Scheda' button in primary Dark Green, high shadow for prominence.

sections.name: Storico Contatti (Protected)
sections.description: Password protected list view. Includes filters (Priority/Fair/Company) and CSV Export button.

components_customization.button: Rounded-xl, heavy font weight. Primary: bg-[#1A432B] hover:bg-[#133821] text-white. Secondary: border-2 border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] bg-transparent hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-white.
components_customization.input: Rounded-xl, border-gray-300, min-h-[56px] (critical touch ergonomics), focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A432B] focus:border-transparent. Padding p-4. Text base or larger.
components_customization.textarea: Rounded-xl, border-gray-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A432B]. Padding p-4.
components_customization.card: Border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm. Use gold accent borders (border-l-4 border-[#C5A059]) for key sections.

images.description: Subtle dark green texture for login/history view backgrounds to contrast with the clean white data entry form.
Fresh artichokes image, can be used softly in the success/thank you screen or empty state of the history view.

logos.description: Construct typography-based logo: Text 'BUSCEMA' in Dark Green (#1A432B) + Lucide 'ChefHat' icon in Gold (#C5A059).

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, rating stars, toggles) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., 'submit-lead-button', 'priority-a-radio', 'star-rating-4', 'company-type-chip').

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind colors with custom Buscema brand palette (Primary: #1A432B, Accent: #C5A059).
Build a single vertically scrolling column for the data entry form, wrapped in a container that constraints width on desktop.
Implement the 'Valutazione' section with an interactive 5-star rating using the lucide-react 'Star' icon.
Company types should be tap-friendly chips (rounded badges, e.g. min-h-[48px] with distinct active states) instead of a native select, for better 1-tap mobile ergonomics.
The Save Contact (Salva Scheda) button MUST be contained within a fixed div at the bottom of the viewport with a backdrop blur or solid bg so it doesn't overlap text awkwardly.
The Header must feature a small 3-color bar representing the Italian flag (Green #009246 / White #FFFFFF / Red #CE2B37).
Add a separate route or state for 'Storico Contatti' which requires a password before showing the list of leads.
Include export CSV logic for the Contact History.
Use massive touch targets for EVERYTHING. Minimum height 56px for inputs/buttons.
Follow standard form structure and state management. Do not create complex nested states if unnecessary.
